<!-- Lead with the problem and resulting behavior. Keep the explanation proportional to the change. -->

## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any relevant issue.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. For native behavior, include the exact Krita/platform versions and isolated scratch-document evidence. Say what remains untested; unit tests alone do not establish Krita compatibility.

## Review notes

Mention changed protocol/capability semantics, migration needs, or remaining limitations when relevant. Update documentation alongside behavior changes. Confirm that attachments and committed files contain no tokens, discovery files, personal artwork, or local profiles.
